title: Haridra (Turmeric) Vrana-Ropana & Kusthaghna Provenance
sanskrit_shloka: हरिद्रा कटुतिक्तोष्णा कफपित्तविनाशिनी। त्वग्दोषहन्त्री मेहामव्रणशोधिनी रोपणी॥
shloka_transliteration: Haridrā kaṭu-tiktōṣṇā kaphapitta-vināśinī. Tvag-dōṣa-hantrī mēhāma-vraṇa-śōdhinī rōpaṇī.
english_translation: Haridra (Curcuma longa) is pungent and bitter in taste, hot in potency, and pacifies Kapha and Pitta. It cures skin diseases (Kustha), diabetes (Meha), cleanses ulcers and wounds (Vrana-shodhana), and accelerates tissue healing (Vrana-ropana).
provenance_evidence: Codified in classical Palm-Leaf manuscripts preserved in Varanasi and Saraswathi Mahal Library. Proves that topical wound healing and anti-inflammatory properties of Turmeric originated in India over 3,000 years ago.
defensive_patent_status: Pre-dates all modern global patents by 3 millennia. Direct prior art that caused the historic revocation of US Patent 5,401,504 (University of Mississippi) by CSIR in 1997. Barred under Section 3(p) of the Indian Patents Act, 1970.

title: Nimba (Neem) Krimighna & Agricultural Antifungal Provenance
sanskrit_shloka: निम्बः शीतो लघुर्ग्राही तिक्तः पाके कटुर्लघुः। कृमिपित्तविषघ्नश्च कुष्ठघ्नः सर्वदोषजित्॥
shloka_transliteration: Nimbaḥ śītō laghurgrāhī tiktaḥ pākē kaṭurlaghuḥ. Kṛmi-pitta-viṣaghnaśca kuṣṭhaghnaḥ sarvadōṣajit.
english_translation: Nimba (Azadirachta indica) is cooling, light to digest, astringent, and bitter. It destroys microbes/insects (Krimi), pacifies Pitta, neutralizes toxins, cures chronic skin pathologies, and balances all doshas.
provenance_evidence: Documented in ancient Vrikshayurveda (Science of Plant Life by Surapala, c. 10th Century CE) and Sushruta Samhita for protecting crops, granaries, and human skin from fungal infestation and pests.
defensive_patent_status: Cited by India in the landmark 10-year legal opposition that led to the revocation of European Patent EP 0436257 (W.R. Grace & USDA) in May 2000. 100% anticipated under Section 3(p).

title: Chyawanprash Avaleha Rasayana Provenance
geographic_origin: Dhosi Hill / Haryana & Brahmavarta, Ancient India
sanskrit_shloka: इत्ययं च्यवनप्राशः परमुक्तो रसायनः। कासश्वासहरश्चैव विशेषेणोपदिश्यते॥ क्षीणक्षतानां वृद्धानां बालानां चाङ्गवर्धनः।
shloka_transliteration: Ityayaṁ cyavanaprāśaḥ paramuktō rasāyanaḥ. Kāsa-śvāsaharaścaiva viśēṣēṇōpadiśyatē. Kṣīṇa-kṣatānāṁ vṛddhānāṁ bālānāṁ cāṅgavardhanaḥ.
english_translation: This Chyawanprash is the supreme Rasayana (rejuvenator). It is especially prescribed for chronic cough, asthma, bronchitis, pulmonary debility, wasting in the elderly, and physical growth in children.
provenance_evidence: Ancient Sanskrit formulation combining 40+ Indian botanicals (Amalaki, Dashamoola, Pippali, Vanshalochan) in a standardized Amla pulp and ghee matrix. Documented in all First Schedule authoritative texts.
defensive_patent_status: Absolute Traditional Knowledge in the public domain. Any attempt to patent standard Chyawanprash or simple sugar-free variants is barred under Section 3(p) and Section 3(e).

title: Triphala Formulation (Three Myrobalans) Provenance
sanskrit_shloka: हरीतकी बिभीतकी धात्री च त्रिफला स्मृता। चक्षुष्या दीपनी श्रेष्ठा कफपित्तप्रणाशिनी॥
shloka_transliteration: Harītakī bibhītakī dhātrī ca triphalā smṛtā. Cakṣuṣyā dīpanī śrēṣṭhā kaphapitta-praṇāśinī.
english_translation: The combination of Haritaki (Terminalia chebula), Bibhitaki (Terminalia bellirica), and Dhatri/Amalaki (Phyllanthus emblica) is called Triphala. It is the premier ophthalmic toner (Chakshushya), digestive stimulant (Deepani), and detoxifier.
provenance_evidence: Formulated in equal harmonic proportions since 1000 BCE. Codified in Buddhist Tripitaka medical commentaries and Tibetan Tanjur translations showing Indian origin.
defensive_patent_status: Public domain traditional medicine. Barred under Section 3(p) and Section 3(e) (mere admixture). Prohibits patenting of Triphala extracts for digestive or cosmetic applications.
biological_resource: Terminalia chebula, Terminalia bellirica, Phyllanthus emblica

title: Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera) Balya & Rasayana Provenance
geographic_origin: Northwestern & Central Ancient India (Madhya Pradesh & Rajasthan)
sanskrit_shloka: अश्वगन्धा कटुस्तिक्ता कषायोष्णा रसायनी। बल्या विदारिहन्त्री च कफवातविनाशिनी॥
shloka_transliteration: Aśvagandhā kaṭustiktā kaṣāyōṣṇā rasāyanī. Balyā vidāri-hantrī ca kaphavāta-vināśinī.
english_translation: Ashwagandha possesses pungent, bitter, and astringent taste, hot potency, and acts as a supreme Rasayana (rejuvenator/adaptogen). It imparts physical stamina (Balya), relieves emaciation, and balances Kapha and Vata.
provenance_evidence: Recorded in over 600 classical Ayurvedic formulations. Sourced from the dry deciduous forests of India. Classical treatises describe root processing in milk (Ksheerapaka) for cognitive and physical vigor.
defensive_patent_status: Used by CSIR-TKDL to defeat foreign patent claims at the European Patent Office (e.g. EP 2879685 by Amorepacific for skin whitening). Barred under Section 3(p); requires NBA Form III clearance.

title: Swarna Prashana (Pediatric Gold Bhasma & Medhya) Provenance
sanskrit_shloka: सुवर्णप्राशनं ह्येतन्मेधाग्निबलवर्धनम्। आयुष्यं मङ्गलं पुण्यं वृष्यं वर्ण्यं ग्रहापहम्॥ मासात् परमामेधावी व्याधिभिर्न च धृष्यते।
shloka_transliteration: Suvarṇaprāśanaṁ hyētan-mēdhāgni-balavardhanam. Āyuṣyaṁ maṅgalaṁ puṇyaṁ vṛṣyaṁ varṇyaṁ grahāpaham. Māsāt paramamēdhāvī vyādhibhirna ca dhṛṣyatē.
english_translation: Swarna Prashana (administration of purified gold with honey and Brahmi/Ghee to children) enhances memory (Medha), digestive power (Agni), physical strength (Bala), promotes longevity, complexional glow, and immunity against childhood infections.
provenance_evidence: The world's oldest codified pediatric immunomodulation protocol. Discloses ancient Indian nanomedicine (Swarna Bhasma - calcined gold nanoparticles) formulated with herbal bio-vehicles.
defensive_patent_status: Establishes ancient Indian prior art for nano-gold therapeutic immunity and memory enhancement. Unpatentable under Section 3(p) and Section 3(e).
biological_resource: Purified Calx of Gold (Swarna) + Bacopa monnieri + Madhu

title: Brahmi Ghrita (Bacopa Nootropic Lipid Formulation) Provenance
geographic_origin: Sindh, Malabar & Ancient Kerala (Gurukulas of Western Ghats)
sanskrit_shloka: ब्राह्मीरसवचाकुष्ठशङ्खपुष्पीभिरेव च। सिद्धं घृतं पिबेन्मेध्यमुन्मादापस्मृतिप्रणुत्॥
shloka_transliteration: Brāhmī-rasa-vacā-kuṣṭha-śaṅkhapuṣpībhirēva ca. Siddhaṁ ghṛtaṁ pibēn-mēdhyam-unmādāpasmṛti-praṇut.
english_translation: Ghee processed with fresh juice of Brahmi (Bacopa monnieri), Vacha (Acorus calamus), Kushtha (Saussurea lappa), and Shankhapushpi (Convolvulus pluricaulis) is the supreme nootropic lipid tonic that cures memory loss, epilepsy (Apasmara), and psychosis.
provenance_evidence: Pioneered the use of liposomal/lipid-soluble drug delivery across the blood-brain barrier (BBB) using Cow's Ghee (Ghrita) as a yogavahi bio-carrier in ancient India.
defensive_patent_status: Direct prior art preventing international monopoly over Bacopa-based cognitive enhancement formulations under Section 3(p).
biological_resource: Bacopa monnieri (L.) Wettst. + Cow's Clarified Butter

title: Trikatu Churna (Bio-Enhancer Yogavahi Formula) Provenance
sanskrit_shloka: पिप्पली मरिचं शुण्ठी त्रिकटुकं समं त्रयम्। दीपनं श्लेष्ममेदोघ्नं कुष्ठपीनसनाशनम्॥
shloka_transliteration: Pippalī maricaṁ śuṇṭhī trikaṭukaṁ samaṁ trayam. Dīpanaṁ ślēṣma-mēdōghnaṁ kuṣṭha-pīnasa-nāśanam.
english_translation: Equal parts of Pippali (Piper longum), Maricha (Piper nigrum), and Shunthi (Zingiber officinale) constitute Trikatu. It stimulates gastric fire, destroys excess fat/metabolic toxins, and treats respiratory rhinitis.
provenance_evidence: First recorded system of pharmacological bioavailability enhancement (Yogavahitwa) in world medical literature, enabling low doses of therapeutic drugs to be effectively absorbed.
defensive_patent_status: Ancient Indian prior art proving that combining black pepper / long pepper (Piperine) with other herbs is public domain traditional knowledge under Section 3(p) and 3(e).
biological_resource: Zingiber officinale, Piper nigrum, Piper longum

title: Sitopaladi Churna (Classical Respiratory Compound) Provenance
sanskrit_shloka: सितोपला षोडश स्यादष्टौ स्याद्वंशलोचना। पिप्पली स्याच्चतुष्कर्षा द्विकर्षैला त्वगेकिका॥ चूर्णमेकत्र संयोज्य लेहयेन्मधुसर्पिषा।
shloka_transliteration: Sitōpalā ṣōḍaśa syād-aṣṭau syād-vaṁśalōcanā. Pippalī syāc-catuṣkarṣā dvi-karṣailā tvagēkikā. Cūrṇam-ēkatra saṁyōjya lēhayēn-madhu-sarpiṣā.
english_translation: Take Sugar candy (16 parts), Bamboo manna / Vanshalochan (8 parts), Pippali (4 parts), Ela / Cardamom (2 parts), and Cinnamon bark (1 part). Mix together and administer with honey and ghee for cough, fever, and bronchial wasting.
provenance_evidence: The harmonic geometric ratio (16:8:4:2:1) is documented in medieval Sanskrit palm-leaf manuscripts and remains one of India's most widely consumed respiratory medications.
defensive_patent_status: Codified in AFI Part-I (7:36). Summarily excluded from patentability under Section 3(p) and Section 3(e).
biological_resource: Bambusa arundinacea, Piper longum, Elettaria cardamomum, Cinnamomum verum

title: Bakuchi (Psoralea corylifolia) for Shvitra / Vitiligo Provenance
sanskrit_shloka: बाकुची मधुरा तिक्ता कटुपाका रसायनी। रुक्षा हृद्या कफं श्वित्रं कुष्ठं हन्ति विशेषतः॥
shloka_transliteration: Bākucī madhurā tiktā kaṭupākā rasāyanī. Rukṣā hṛdyā kaphaṁ śvitraṁ kuṣṭhaṁ hanti viśēṣataḥ.
english_translation: Bakuchi (Psoralea corylifolia) is sweet and bitter, pungent post-digestion, and rejuvenating. It specifically destroys Shvitra (vitiligo / leucoderma) and chronic skin lesions when used with sun exposure.
provenance_evidence: Documents the ancient Indian discovery of PUVA-like (Psoralen + Ultraviolet sunlight phototherapy) over 500 years before modern Western dermatology discovered psoralen photochemotherapy.
defensive_patent_status: Proves Indian ancestral priority for vitiligo treatment using Psoralea extracts. Non-patentable under Section 3(p).

title: Arogyavardhini Vati (Hepatic & Metabolic Regulator) Provenance
ancient_treatise: Rasaratna Samuccaya (19th Adhyaya) & Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Kushtharoga Adhikara)
sanskrit_shloka: आरोग्यवर्धिनी नाम्ना वटी सर्वगदापहा। दीपिनी पाचनी हृद्या मेदोदोषविनाशिनी॥ यकृद्विकारे पाण्डौ च कुष्ठेषु च विशेषतः।
shloka_transliteration: Ārōgyavardhinī nāmnā vaṭī sarva-gadāpahā. Dīpinī pācanī hṛdyā mēdō-dōṣa-vināśinī. Yakṛd-vikārē pāṇḍau ca kuṣṭhēṣu ca viśēṣataḥ.
english_translation: This formulation called Arogyavardhini Vati destroys all diseases, stimulates liver metabolism, clears accumulated lipids, and is specially indicated in hepatic cirrhosis, fatty liver, jaundice, and chronic dermatoses.
provenance_evidence: Complex multi-herb-mineral formulation combining Katuki (Picrorhiza kurroa), Nimba, Triphala, Guggulu, and purified minerals processed in Nimba leaf juice.
defensive_patent_status: Codified in AFI Part-I (20:4). Excluded from patentability worldwide as an ancient Ayurvedic prior art formulation under Section 3(p).

title: Shallaki (Boswellia serrata) for Sandhivata / Arthritis Provenance
sanskrit_shloka: शल्लकी तुवरा तिक्ता मधुरा शीतला तथा। पित्तकफव्रणान् हन्ति शोथं सन्धिगतं जयेत्॥
shloka_transliteration: Śallakī tuvarā tiktā madhurā śītalā tathā. Pitta-kapha-vraṇān hanti śōthaṁ sandhigataṁ jayēt.
english_translation: Shallaki (Boswellia resin) is astringent, bitter, and cooling. It heals wounds, subdues inflammation (Shotha), and relieves pain and swelling in osteoarthritis and degenerative joint conditions (Sandhivata).
provenance_evidence: Harvested from Indian Boswellia trees across Madhya Pradesh and Gujarat since antiquity. Sages prescribed the oleo-gum resin for joint mobility and chronic bowel colitis.
defensive_patent_status: Precludes broad patent claims on Boswellia gum extracts or Boswellic acid formulations for arthritis under Section 3(p).

title: Meshashringi (Gymnema / Gurmar) for Madhumeha Provenance
sanskrit_shloka: मेषशृङ्गी कषायोष्णा तिक्ता च मदनाशिनी। प्रमेहं श्वासकासौ च हन्ति चक्षुर्हिता परा॥
shloka_transliteration: Mēṣaśṛṅgī kaṣāyōṣṇā tiktā ca madanāśinī. Pramēhaṁ śvāsa-kāsau ca hanti cakṣurhitā parā.
english_translation: Meshashringi (Gymnema sylvestre / Gurmar) is astringent, hot in virya, and bitter. It destroys the sensation of sweetness, regulates urinary sugar excretion in Prameha (diabetes), and relieves cough.
provenance_evidence: Known classically as 'Madhunashini' (Sugar Destroyer) for over 2,500 years in Indian Ayurvedic medicine. Used in decoctions for metabolic disorders.
defensive_patent_status: Used by CSIR to invalidate European patent claims (EP 1841440) claiming anti-diabetic herbal extracts. Non-patentable under Section 3(p).

title: Yograj Guggulu (Amavata & Musculoskeletal Compound) Provenance
sanskrit_shloka: योगराज इति ख्यातो गुग्गुलुः परमामृतम्। आमवातं निहन्त्याशु वातरक्तं सुदारुणम्॥
shloka_transliteration: Yōgarāja iti khyātō gugguluḥ paramāmṛtam. Āmavātaṁ nihantyāśu vātaraktaṁ sudāruṇam.
english_translation: This celebrated formula Yograj Guggulu acts like supreme nectar. It swiftly cures rheumatoid arthritis (Amavata), severe gout (Vatarakta), sciatica, and neurological disorders.
provenance_evidence: Combines purified Commiphora mukul (Guggulu) with 27 classical herbs processed in Castor oil (Eranda taila) for synergistic deep-tissue penetration.
defensive_patent_status: Codified in AFI Part-I (5:7). Any attempt to patent combinations of Guggulu with Indian spices for arthritis is directly barred under Section 3(p) and 3(e).

title: The Four Medhya Rasayanas (Nootropic Sages Protocol) Provenance
sanskrit_shloka: मण्डूकपर्ण्याः स्वरसः प्रयोज्यः क्षीरेण यष्टीमधुकस्य चूर्णम्। रसो गुडूच्यास्तु समूलपुष्प्याः कल्कः प्रयोज्यः खलु शङ्खपुष्प्याः॥ मेध्यानि चैतानि रसायनानि।
shloka_transliteration: Maṇḍūkaparṇyāḥ svarasaḥ prayōjyaḥ kṣīrēṇa yaṣṭīmadhukasya cūrṇam. Rasō guḍūcyāstu samūlapuṣpyāḥ kalkaḥ prayōjyaḥ khalu śaṅkhapuṣpyāḥ. Mēdhyāni caitāni rasāyanāni.
english_translation: The four supreme cognitive rejuvenators (Medhya Rasayanas) are: (1) Fresh juice of Mandukaparni (Centella asiatica), (2) Powder of Yashtimadhu with milk, (3) Fresh extract of Guduchi (Tinospora cordifolia), and (4) Whole plant paste of Shankhapushpi (Convolvulus pluricaulis). They prolong life, cure mental debility, and impart extraordinary intellect.
provenance_evidence: The earliest documented cognitive neuroprotective protocol in world history, establishing India's exclusive discovery of nootropic herbal synergies.
defensive_patent_status: Direct prior art defeating modern claims attempting to patent Centella asiatica (Gotu Kola) or Convolvulus extracts for memory enhancement under Section 3(p).
biological_resource: Centella asiatica, Convolvulus pluricaulis, Tinospora cordifolia

title: Makaradhwaja & Kajjali Mineral Alchemy Provenance
sanskrit_shloka: कज्जली सर्वलोहानां रसायनानामुत्तमा। मकरध्वजसंयुक्तं त्रिदोषघ्नं रसायनम्॥
shloka_transliteration: Kajjalī sarva-lōhānāṁ rasāyanānām-uttamā. Makaradhvaja-saṁyuktaṁ tridōṣaghnaṁ rasāyanam.
english_translation: Kajjali (black mercury sulfide nano-crystals) is the supreme catalytic base. When processed with Gold (Swarna) and calcined in Valuka Yantra, it yields Makaradhwaja, a peerless cardiac tonic, aphrodisiac, and longevity promoter.
provenance_evidence: Demonstrates India's advanced ancient Rasashastra (mineral nanochemistry) utilizing controlled sublimation techniques centuries before modern crystal chemistry.
defensive_patent_status: Proves Indian ownership of herbo-metallic nanoparticle compounds under Section 3(p).

title: Ksheerabala Taila 101 Avarthana (Neuro-Regenerative) Provenance
sanskrit_shloka: क्षीरबला समायुक्ता शतपाकविधानतः। वातरक्तं जयत्याशु पक्षाघातं सुदारुणम्॥
shloka_transliteration: Kṣīrabalā samāyuktā śatapāka-vidhānataḥ. Vātaraktaṁ jayatyāśu pakṣāghātaṁ sudāruṇam.
english_translation: Ksheerabala processed 101 times (Shata-paka) with Sida cordifolia (Bala root), Cow's Milk, and Sesame Oil penetrates the deepest nerve tissues, curing hemiplegia (Pakshaghata), facial palsy, and motor neuron disorders.
provenance_evidence: Unique Indian sequential potence-multiplication process (Avarthana) developed by the Ashtavaidya lineages of Kerala.
defensive_patent_status: Precludes patenting of Sida cordifolia lipid extracts for neuropathy under Section 3(p).
biological_resource: Sida cordifolia (Bala) + Cow's Milk + Sesamum indicum

title: Siddha Nilavembu Kudineer (Andrographis Antiviral) Provenance
ancient_treatise: Agathiyar Gunavagadam (அகத்தியர் குணவாகடம்) & Siddha Formulary of India
sanskrit_shloka: நிலவேம்பு வெட்டிவேர் விளாமிச்சை சந்தனம் பேய்ப்புடல் கோரைக்கிழங்கு சுக்கு மிளகு திப்பிலி சேர்ந்த கஷாயம் சுரம் போக்கும்.
shloka_transliteration: Nilavēmbu veṭṭivēr viḷāmiccai candanam pēyppuḍal kōraikkiḻaṅgu sukku miḷagu tippili sērnda kaṣāyam suram pōkkum.
english_translation: Decoction prepared with Nilavembu (Andrographis paniculata), Vetiver, Sandalwood, Snake gourd, Nutgrass, and Trikatu destroys all severe viral fevers, dengue, and joint arthralgia.
provenance_evidence: Ancient Tamil palm-leaf medical texts codified by the 18 Siddhars, proving indigenous Southern Indian discovery of Andrographis antiviral therapy.
defensive_patent_status: Cited to defeat European patent EP 1912644 claiming Andrographis for swine flu. 100% barred under Section 3(p).

title: Tulasi & Vasa (Ocimum & Adhatoda Respiratory Decoction) Provenance
sanskrit_shloka: तुलसी कटुतिक्तोष्णा कफकासविनाशिनी। वासा तिक्ता कषाया च रक्तपित्तकफापहा॥
shloka_transliteration: Tulasī kaṭu-tiktōṣṇā kapha-kāsa-vināśinī. Vāsā tiktā kaṣāyā ca rakta-pitta-kaphāpahā.
english_translation: Tulsi (Ocimum sanctum) relieves bronchial cough and recurrent fevers. Vasa (Adhatoda vasica) is bitter and astringent, expanding bronchioles and halting hemoptysis (coughing blood) and pulmonary congestion.
provenance_evidence: Vasicine and Eugenol active therapeutic mechanisms were discovered empirically through these classical formulations over a thousand years ago.
defensive_patent_status: Direct prior art preventing proprietary botanical patents on Tulsi/Vasa cough syrups under Section 3(p).
biological_resource: Ocimum sanctum L. + Adhatoda vasica Nees

title: Kumaryasava (Aloe Vera Classical Asava-Arishta) Provenance
sanskrit_shloka: कुमार्यासव इत्येष यकृत्प्लीहोदरापहः। पाण्डुहृद्रोगशमनः कासश्वासहरो वरः॥
shloka_transliteration: Kumāryāsava ityēṣa yakṛt-plīhōdarāpahaḥ. Pāṇḍu-hṛdrōga-śamanaḥ kāsa-śvāsa-harō varaḥ.
english_translation: Kumaryasava (naturally fermented bio-active elixir of Aloe vera pulp with Dhataki flowers and iron calx) cures spleen and liver enlargement, anemia, gynecological dysmenorrhea, and respiratory debility.
provenance_evidence: Ancient Indian biological fermentation methodology utilizing self-generated 5-10% natural alcohol for preserving thermo-labile phytoconstituents.
defensive_patent_status: Codified in AFI Part-I (1:11). Section 3(p) prohibits patenting Aloe vera fermented drinks.

title: Dashamoola Kwatha (Ten Sacred Roots Neuro-Vata Compound) Provenance
sanskrit_shloka: बिल्वकाश्मर्यतर्कारीपाटलाटिण्टुका बृहत्। शालपर्णी पृश्निपर्णी बृहती कण्टकारिका गोक्षुरश्चेति दशमूलम्॥ वातश्लेष्मविकारघ्नं सूतिकारोगनाशनम्।
shloka_transliteration: Bilva-kāśmarya-tarkārī-pāṭalā-ṭiṇṭukā bṛhat. Śālaparṇī pṛśniparṇī bṛhatī kaṇṭakārikā gōkṣuraścēti daśamūlam. Vāta-ślēṣma-vikāraghnaṁ sūtikā-rōga-nāśanam.
english_translation: The Ten Roots comprise Bilva, Agnimantha, Shyonaka, Patala, Gambhari (Brihat Panchamoola) and Shalaparni, Prishniparni, Brihati, Kantakari, Gokshura (Laghu Panchamoola). It pacifies severe neuro-inflammatory Vata conditions and ensures maternal post-partum healing.
provenance_evidence: Documented since Vedic times as the supreme ecological polyherbal root synergy in ancient Indian medical practice.
defensive_patent_status: Codified in AFI Part-I (4:15). Public domain traditional medicine under Section 3(p).
biological_resource: Ten Roots Botanical Complex (Aegle marmelos, Premna integrifolia, etc.)
